_summary.source: WebP build renders in Thumb.png of Tuning_* containers (zero saves made); wheel icons from the BC7 icon dump
_summary.method: front wheel located from the opaque-alpha bottom contour (chord-fit radius, manual override on 7 lowered cars); matcher = per-radius z-normalised polar image (circular high-pass), rotation-max NCC + spoke-count harmonic gating + spectral cosine, scale scan 0.50-0.92 of tyre radius, centre/aspect refinement; aggregate = mean over an id's wheels. Every matched/ambiguous verdict was made by eye on crop-vs-icon comparison sheets; the matcher only supplied candidates.
caveats: names are derived from icon stems (brand code + model), NOT from the EN string table; e.g. the in-game Torq Thrust name may be 'VN215 Torq Thrust D', which changes its sort position
rim colour is a paint option and was ignored; matches rest on spoke geometry
rear-wheel-only ids (rear_rim_style != rim_style) are oblique and low-confidence
'HOL' brand code unresolved (Hole Star / Sun Star / Solid); it sorts between Halibrand and HRE either way
matcher aggregate top-1 agreed with the eye verdict on only ~10 ids; spoke-count detection is unreliable on wheels under ~45 px radius

candidate lists for the second-pass zooms were seeded from the alphabetical prior (brand predicted by id position) and then judged by eye; ids whose verdict came from such a sheet: 13153,13154,13619,13620,13673,13675,13701,13970,13973,14027,665,13808,13867,13874,13894,13981,14028,14037

alphabetical_batch_test.hypothesis: within each id batch, in-game names ascend alphabetically (brand, then model) with id
